introduction.section1: The Grand Est region, located in north-east France, offers a beautiful diversity of landscapes. From Alsace with its flowered villages, to the Champagne vineyards, passing through the Vosges mountains and the Lorraine plains, each territory has its own charm. Discover iconic cities like Strasbourg, Colmar, Nancy or Reims, without forgetting the famous Christmas markets that make the region known. Grand Est promises beautiful discoveries.
